purpose: Lifecycle status for every render pass / pipeline family so future slices MOVE a pass one step forward instead of re-deciding from scratch whether it should be modeled. Source of truth for scripts/check-pass-coverage.py.

status_legend.UNREGISTERED: ad-hoc GL state; no PipelineDesc row. next = register (or recon).
status_legend.DESCRIPTIVE_REGISTERED: PipelineDesc row exists + checked, but NOT applied via applyPipeline (state still hand-set).
status_legend.VISUAL_PROVEN: routed AND a before/after pixel-identical (or perceptual) gate passed.
status_legend.SPIRV_ELIGIBLE: visual-proven AND the shader family is baked + selectable as offline SPIR-V.
status_legend.DO_NOT_MODEL: intentionally never a static PipelineDesc row (dynamic-state emulator, non-draw, or not-a-pass). REQUIRES reason.
